name: Lynx
summary: The classic text-based web browser — navigate the web from your terminal
description:
Lynx is the world's oldest actively maintained web browser. It renders web pages as plain text in your terminal, making it perfect for:

• Browsing the web on headless servers or over SSH
• Fast, distraction-free reading without JavaScript, CSS, or ads
• Accessibility — works with screen readers and braille displays
• Low-bandwidth connections and ancient hardware
• Scripting and automation of web tasks

Lynx supports HTTPS, cookies, authentication, and HTML forms. It doesn't support JavaScript, CSS, or modern web apps — but for text-heavy sites (Wikipedia, documentation, news, forums) it's often faster and cleaner than any graphical browser.

KEYSTROKES
• G or g — Go to URL
• ↓/↑ or Tab/Shift+Tab — Navigate links
• → or Enter — Follow link
• ← or Backspace — Go back
• H — Help screen
• Q — Quit
• / — Search within page
• = — Page info (URL, size, etc.)
• ! — Shell escape
• Ctrl+R — Reload

INSTALLATION
Available in the official Arch repositories. Just run the install command below and press Enter — no password needed for the store package.

featured.headline: The web. Just text. Since 1992.
featured.tagline: Lynx is the classic text-based browser — no JavaScript, no CSS, no bloat. Perfect for servers, SSH, accessibility, or distraction-free reading. Navigate with arrow keys, search with /, quit with Q. The oldest browser still in active development.

features.title: Pure text browsing
features.body: Lynx renders HTML as clean, readable text. No scripts, no styles, no tracking — just the content you came for.

features.title: Headless & SSH ready
features.body: Runs in any terminal. Browse the web from a remote server, a VM, or a TTY without a graphical environment.

features.title: Accessibility first
features.body: Works natively with screen readers and braille displays. Semantic HTML navigation makes it a powerful assistive tool.

features.title: Lightning fast
features.body: No JavaScript engine, no CSS parser, no image loading. Pages load in milliseconds even on slow connections.

features.title: Keyboard-driven
features.body: Every action is a keystroke. Arrow keys to navigate, Enter to follow, Backspace to go back, / to search, Q to quit.

features.title: Privacy by default
features.body: No cookies by default, no localStorage, no fingerprinting surface. You control exactly what gets sent.

steps.title: Install Lynx
steps.body: Run the install command below. It's in the official Arch repos — no AUR needed.

steps.title: Start browsing
steps.body: Type 'lynx' followed by a URL (e.g. 'lynx https://wiki.archlinux.org') or just 'lynx' to start at the default homepage.
